settings.siteDescription: A luminous artist portfolio for Swati Yadav featuring expressive photography, paintings, and contact information.

home.intro: Swati Yadav is an agronomist, research assistant breeder, B2B relationship manager, and agri advisor who brings curiosity, creative thinking, and care to every growing system and human connection.
highlights: Agronomist working with exotic and domestic leafy vegetables
Research assistant breeder at ORBI Seeds, Bengaluru
Clear communicator, relationship builder, and lifelong learner
home.artistNote: She works across crop science and communication, from cocopeat substrate and lettuce NFT systems to practical advice that helps people make confident decisions.
home.contactCopy: Driven by perseverance, small self-set challenges, and a belief that thoughtful work can help people and plants thrive.
home.showcaseCopy: A gallery-style arrangement of featured works, balancing painterly warmth with crisp photographic storytelling.

about.title: A curious mind with dirt under her fingernails.
about.intro: Swati Yadav is a research assistant breeder, agronomist, and who believes that meaningful growth is built through patience, attention, and daily practice.
about.body: Her work moves between the precision of crop science and the human work of communication. She enjoys understanding a system deeply, making it more useful for others, and staying open to the lessons that arrive along the way.

values.title: Keep learning
values.copy: Every crop, conversation, and challenge is an invitation to become more capable.

values.title: Stay connected
values.copy: Good work grows through clear communication, trust, and shared responsibility.

values.title: Begin again
values.copy: Perseverance means returning to the work with a little more understanding each time.

journey.title: Perseverance as a practice
journey.copy: Swati believes progress is made in the small decisions that are repeated with care. She gives herself small challenges, asks better questions, and keeps returning to the work until the person she is becoming feels a little more precise than the person she was yesterday.
journey.detail: A personal philosophy of patience, curiosity, and purposeful effort.

journey.title: Learning from every landscape
journey.copy: Travel gives Swati a different kind of classroom. New roads, local food systems, changing weather, and unfamiliar conversations sharpen her attention and remind her that every place has its own rhythm. She returns with photographs, notes, and a wider way of seeing.
journey.detail: Moving through the world slowly enough to notice what it is teaching.

journey.title: Growing better from the root
journey.copy: As an agronomist, Swati works across exotic and domestic leafy vegetables, cocopeat substrate systems, and lettuce production on NFT. Her work brings together observation, crop care, and practical problem-solving to help plants perform in controlled and changing environments.
journey.detail: Exotic and domestic leafy vegetables · Cocopeat substrate · Lettuce NFT systems

journey.title: Curiosity in the field and the lab
journey.copy: As a research assistant breeder at ORBI Seeds, a Bengaluru-based company, Swati supports the patient work of understanding, selecting, and improving crops. She approaches research with strong communication and interpersonal skills, connecting careful observation with the people and decisions that move a project forward.
journey.detail: Research assistant breeder at ORBI Seeds · Bengaluru

blog.title: Notes from the road.
blog.intro: A collage of passing landscapes, soft arrivals, and the small emotions that stay long after the journey has moved on.

contact.title: Let’s make something with feeling.
contact.intro: For commissions, exhibitions, editorial work, or a thoughtful collaboration, send a note and tell me what you are imagining.
contact.availability: Currently welcoming select commissions, gallery features, and creative collaborations.

artworks.title: Golden Silence
artworks.description: Soft morning light, quiet architecture, and a stillness that turns a fleeting scene into memory.
artworks.details: A study of the hour when warm light gives familiar spaces a new kind of quiet.

artworks.title: Sunny Day on Beach
artworks.description: Layered color fields inspired by rain-soaked gardens and petals holding the last of the storm.
artworks.details: Paint, water, and saturated color gather into a garden that feels both fleeting and enduring.

artworks.title: City After Rain
artworks.description: Reflective streets and neon mist, balancing documentary detail with cinematic atmosphere.
artworks.details: An evening image about reflections, movement, and the brief glow that follows a storm.

artworks.title: Earthsong
artworks.description: A textured composition of sienna, clay, and ash, echoing handmade pigments and intimate gestures.
artworks.details: Built from earthy layers, this piece follows the physical rhythm of pigment meeting canvas.

artworks.title: Window Light Study
artworks.description: Portrait-like still life work that explores shadow edges, fabric folds, and gentle human presence.
artworks.details: A square meditation on the soft geometry of afternoon light across an intimate interior.

artworks.title: The Unrhythmic Paradox
artworks.description: A new study in color, texture, and quiet movement across the canvas.
artworks.details: Color shifts and irregular marks create a measured tension between stillness and motion.

journal.title: The First Light Finds Us
journal.intro: A narrow road, a patient horizon, and the feeling that the day has only just begun.
paragraphs: I kept walking until the ordinary became luminous. The light moved gently across the scene, asking for attention rather than explanation. This was the kind of view that made the journey feel personal.
There was no itinerary for this moment, only the soft rhythm of looking and the quiet pleasure of letting the landscape set the pace. Somewhere between arrival and departure, I found room to breathe.

I carried a small challenge with me: look again, stay curious, and let the view be different from what I expected. The smallest details stayed longest: a shift in weather, a sound in the distance, a colour I could not name.

By the time I turned back, the place had become a memory in progress, proof that a brief pause can change the shape of an entire day. I left with less urgency and a wider sense of time, carrying this frame home as a quiet reminder.

There was no itinerary for this moment, only the soft rhythm of looking and the quiet pleasure of letting the landscape set the pace. Somewhere between arrival and departure, I found room to breathe.

I carried a small challenge with me: look again, stay curious, and let the view be different from what I expected. The smallest details stayed longest: a shift in weather, a sound in the distance, a colour I could not name.

By the time I turned back, the place had become a memory in progress, proof that a brief pause can change the shape of an entire day. I left with less urgency and a wider sense of time, carrying this frame home as a quiet reminder.
